newsitem.title: USA: FBI's Freeh criticizes Saudis on bomb probe.
newsitem.headline: FBI's Freeh criticizes Saudis on bomb probe.

text.p: FBI Director Louis Freeh criticised Saudi Arabia for frustrating U.S. efforts to determine responsibility for the bombing of a military complex in Dharhan that killed 19 American servicemen, the Washington Post reported on Thursday.

"We have not gotten everything which we have asked for, and sure, that has affected our ability to make findings or conclusions or to channel the investigation in different directions," Freeh told Post editors and reporters at a luncheon meeting on Wednesday.
Freeh's comments marked an unusually public criticism of a key military ally and a turnabout in the Clinton administration's public position on the Saudi's willingness to cooperate.

After a trip to Saudi Arabia in November, Freeh issued a statement praising the "close cooperation" of Saudi officials in the investigation into the attack on the Khobar Towers housing complex last June 25.
During that trip, the Saudis reportedly provided new details to support their claim of Iranian responsibility for the bombing.
But Freeh told the Post he did not have enough information to make "strong findings or conclusions" because what he had been told was "hearsay information in many cases."
"There is a great deal of information that we have not seen," he said.
